gloss: father and child; father and son

definitions.gloss: father and child; father and son
definitions.explanation: A father and his child, considered as a pair. Most often used of a father and son.

examples.japanese: {父子|ふし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}む→営む：11837_itonamu⟧。
examples.english: Father and son run the shop together.

examples.japanese: {父子家庭|ふしかてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: I grew up in a single-father household.

examples.japanese: {父子|ふし}{二代|にだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦プレー→プレー：29432_puree⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になっている。
examples.english: A father and son who have played for the same team across two generations are in the news.

notes:
USAGE:
A written word, common in news reports and official language. In speech people usually say ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧, or ⟦{親子|おやこ}→親子：10430_oyako⟧ when the sex does not matter. The matching words are ⟦{母子|ぼし}→母子：20277_boshi⟧ (mother and child) and ⟦{親子|おやこ}→親子：10430_oyako⟧ (parent and child).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {父子家庭|ふしかてい}: a single-father household
- {父子|ふし}{二代|にだい}: two generations, father and son
- {父子|ふし}⟦{共演|きょうえん}→共演：11676_kyouen⟧: father and son appearing together
